items.title: Simplify the menu to local favorites
items.why: Cutting back on premium add-ons in the food menu maintains quality while saving significant costs for a birthday party.

items.title: DIY games instead of professional host
items.why: You can curate fun, engaging birthday activities yourself to avoid hiring an external entertainer.

answer.summary: The gap is closed by simplifying the food menu and managing the entertainment internally.

items.title: Simplify the menu to a set buffet
items.why: Reducing the variety of items keeps the quality high for 40 guests.

items.title: Host interactive games instead of hiring a DJ
items.why: A curated music playlist and planned games are often more engaging for a birthday.

items.title: Focus on a single photo-booth area
items.why: Concentrating all decor efforts on one spot creates a strong visual impact for photos.

answer.summary: The gap cannot be fully closed this way, but these removals focus the budget on the most essential birthday elements.

items.title: Streamline the menu variety
items.why: Reducing the number of live counters while keeping the main buffet ensures guests are well-fed without overspending.

items.title: Use local foliage and lighting effects
items.why: Focusing on creative lighting and locally sourced greenery creates a grand look for the 250 guests at a lower cost than exotic florals.

items.title: Limit live band hours
items.why: Having the band play for key segments rather than the entire evening keeps the energy high while saving on performance fees.

answer.summary: By optimizing the menu, focusing on lighting-based decor, and refining music hours, we can effectively bridge the budget gap without compromising the guest experience.

items.title: Shift to digital return gifts or personalized sweets
items.why: Eliminating physical hampers for 250 guests is a significant saving that keeps the focus on the wedding experience.

items.title: Streamline the emergency buffer
items.why: Reducing the contingency fund allows us to cover the gap while keeping a smaller reserve for last-minute wedding needs.

items.title: Optimize guest transport routes
items.why: Consolidating pickup points for guests reduces the number of vehicles needed for the event.

answer.summary: We can bridge the gap by streamlining return gift options and optimizing the contingency fund while maintaining core event quality.

items.title: Simplify stage lighting and sound setup
items.why: A smaller, focused sound system is sufficient for community announcements and prayers.

items.title: Shift to community-led performances
items.why: Local talent and residents can lead the cultural segment, removing the need for external performers.

answer.summary: By focusing on community participation and streamlining technical requirements, we can cover the shortfall while keeping the event spirit intact.

items.title: Simplify floral offerings for the deity
items.why: Using seasonal local flowers for the puja maintains the sanctity of the ritual while reducing costs.

items.title: Streamline volunteer meal planning
items.why: Ordering simple, bulk-prepared meals for the volunteer team is more cost-effective than individual portions.

answer.summary: We can cover the small shortfall by making minor adjustments to ritual floral expenses and volunteer logistics without impacting the event experience.
